name: DiamondGlow
title: DiamondGlow Facial in San Clemente, CA | Skin Restore
description: DiamondGlow facial in San Clemente — exfoliation, extraction and serum infusion in one treatment, with five serum options and no downtime.
alt: The DiamondGlow diamond-tip handpiece resurfacing the cheek while a pro-infusion serum is delivered
intro:
Three things at once: exfoliate, extract, infuse. Thirty minutes, no downtime, and you look noticeably better walking out than you did walking in.

DiamondGlow is the treatment we book most often for people who want visible results before a wedding, a reunion or a photoshoot — and for people who just want their skin to look consistently good without committing to recovery time.

sections.html:
A diamond-tipped wand moves across your skin doing three jobs simultaneously.

It exfoliates. The diamond tip resurfaces the outermost layer, removing dead cells and the dullness that comes with them.

It extracts. Gentle suction pulls debris and oil out of pores — no squeezing, no pressure, no lingering redness from manual extraction.

It infuses. At the same moment, a pro-infusion serum is delivered into the freshly exfoliated skin. Because the surface barrier has just been cleared, absorption is dramatically better than anything you can achieve at home.

That last part is what separates DiamondGlow from a standard microdermabrasion. You're not exfoliating and then applying product. It happens in the same pass.

sections.h2: Five serums, one chosen for you
sections.html:
The serum is where we customize:

  • Hydration — for tight, dehydrated or flaky skin
  • Brightening — for dullness, sun damage and uneven tone
  • Clarifying — for congestion, blackheads and oily skin
  • Skin-firming — for laxity and early signs of aging
  • Pore clarifying — for visibly enlarged pores

We'll choose together based on what your skin is doing that day.

• Dull, tired-looking skin
  • Congested pores and blackheads
  • Uneven tone and texture
  • Dryness and dehydration
  • Fine lines
  • Oily, congested skin

The whole appointment runs about 30 to 45 minutes. It's comfortable — most people find the suction pleasant. There's no numbing needed and no stinging.

Afterward, skin may be slightly pink for 15 to 30 minutes. You can put makeup on and go straight back to work or out to dinner. Genuinely zero downtime.

Results are immediate and last roughly two to four weeks. Most clients come in monthly to maintain.

Pricing is confirmed at your consultation, once we've looked at your skin and agreed on a plan. Treatment length, the serums or settings we choose, and any add-ons all affect the cost — so we'd rather quote you accurately than guess.

Call (949) 545-7919 and we'll talk it through.

faqs.q: How is DiamondGlow different from a HydraFacial?
faqs.a: Both exfoliate, extract and hydrate. DiamondGlow uses a physical diamond tip rather than a water-based vortex, and it uses SkinMedica pro-infusion serums. In practice the choice comes down to your skin type and which serum lineup suits your concerns better. We're happy to talk through it.

faqs.q: Can I have this before an event?
faqs.a: Yes — this is the best treatment we offer for that. Book it one to three days before. You get the glow without any risk of a reaction on the day.

faqs.q: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. The tip and suction levels are adjustable and we dial them to your tolerance. Tell us if you're sensitive and we'll start conservatively.

faqs.q: How often should I come in?
faqs.a: Monthly is the sweet spot for most people.

faqs.q: Can I combine it with other treatments?
faqs.a: It pairs beautifully with dermaplaning in the same visit. We wouldn't combine it with a peel on the same day.

name: BREEZE Cryo Oxygen
title: Needle-Free Oxygen Facial in Orange County | Skin Restore
description: BREEZE needle-free oxygen facial in San Clemente — pressurized air infuses actives with lymphatic drainage and exfoliation. Comfortable, no downtime.
alt: The BREEZE handpiece delivering pressurized air and serum to the cheek during a needle-free oxygen facial
h1: Needle-Free Oxygen Facial in San Clemente
intro:
Nothing touches your face but air and active ingredients.

BREEZE™ uses jet-powered technology to drive pressurized air and medical-grade serums into the skin through a needle-free process called hydroporation. It's the most comfortable treatment on our menu, and one of the few genuinely results-driven options for skin that reacts to almost everything.

sections.html:
The handpiece accelerates a fine stream of air and active serum to high velocity. At that speed, the stream does two things at once: it gently exfoliates the surface, and it carries the actives into the deeper layers of the epidermis.

No needle, no abrasive tip, no contact. It feels like a cool, fine mist moving across your skin. Most clients find it genuinely relaxing, and a fair number fall asleep.

Every BREEZE treatment combines three stages, adjusted to your skin:

Lymphatic drainage — encourages fluid movement to reduce puffiness and support circulation Exfoliation — clears dead surface cells without scrubbing or acid Targeted nutrient infusion — serums selected for your specific concern, delivered under pressure

• Dehydration — the single best hydrating treatment we offer
  • Dullness and lack of glow
  • Fine lines from moisture loss
  • Congestion in oily or blocked skin
  • Sensitivity and redness — because nothing abrasive touches the skin, it suits reactive complexions that can't tolerate scrubs or peels
  • Puffiness, including under the eyes

sections.h2: Why it's a good fit for sensitive skin
sections.html:
Most exfoliating treatments work by causing controlled irritation. If your skin is reactive, rosacea-prone or just easily upset, that's a problem.

BREEZE doesn't work that way. There's no acid, no abrasion, no heat. It's one of the very few results-driven treatments we can offer someone whose skin reacts to almost everything — and one of the few that's comfortable enough to do right around the delicate eye area.

Length: 30–45 minutes Sensation: A cool mist. No pain, no numbing needed. Downtime: None. Skin looks plump and hydrated immediately. Results: Visible the same day, lasting two to four weeks.

You can wear makeup straight afterward, though most people don't want to.

Pricing is confirmed at your consultation, once we've looked at your skin and agreed on a plan. Treatment length, the serums or settings we choose, and any add-ons all affect the cost — so we'd rather quote you accurately than guess.

Call (949) 545-7919 and we'll talk it through.

faqs.q: Does it hurt at all?
faqs.a: No. This is the most comfortable treatment on our menu.

faqs.q: How is it different from a chemical peel?
faqs.a: Different goals. A peel works by controlled exfoliation — it resurfaces, and there's usually some flaking afterward. BREEZE doesn't remove anything or cause irritation; it delivers hydration and actives and gives you an immediate result with nothing to recover from. If your skin needs resurfacing, a peel. If it needs hydration and comfort, BREEZE.

faqs.q: Can I have it during pregnancy?
faqs.a: Often yes, depending on the serum. Tell us and we'll select accordingly.

faqs.q: How soon before an event?
faqs.a: Same day is fine. There's nothing to recover from.

faqs.q: Can I combine it with other treatments?
faqs.a: Yes, it finishes beautifully after dermaplaning or a light peel.

name: Wonder Touch RF
title: RF Skin Tightening in Orange County, CA | Skin Restore
description: Wonder Touch radiofrequency skin tightening in San Clemente. Firms, lifts and smooths without surgery, needles or downtime. Results build over a series.
alt: A facial treatment being performed with a slow, massage-like technique
h1: Radiofrequency Skin Tightening in San Clemente
intro:
For skin that's started to lose its firmness — without surgery, needles or downtime.

Wonder Touch combines radiofrequency energy with a slow, massage-like technique. The RF delivers controlled heat into the deeper layers of your skin: deep enough to prompt collagen production, gentle enough that the treatment itself feels like a warm facial massage.

sections.html:
Collagen is what holds skin taut. As it declines with age, skin loses structure and starts to soften along the jaw, cheeks and neck.

Radiofrequency warms the dermis to a controlled temperature. That heat causes existing collagen fibers to contract — a tightening you can often see immediately — and signals the skin to produce new collagen over the following weeks. The massage technique keeps the applicator moving so no area overheats, while encouraging circulation and lymphatic flow at the same time.

The immediate effect is tightening. The lasting effect builds gradually as new collagen forms.

• Early skin laxity along the jawline and cheeks
  • Softening definition around the neck
  • Fine lines and crepey texture
  • Dull skin and sluggish circulation
  • Overall firmness and tone

Length: 45–60 minutes Sensation: Warm and relaxing. Most people compare it to a hot stone massage for the face. Heat is monitored throughout and adjusted to your comfort. Downtime: None. Slight flushing that settles within the hour. Immediately after: Skin looks firmer and more lifted. Over time: Results build over 8–12 weeks as collagen forms.

Protocol: Most people need a series of six treatments spaced one to two weeks apart, then maintenance every few months. One session gives you a lovely temporary lift — it won't produce lasting change on its own. We'd rather tell you that up front than sell you a single session and let you feel let down.

sections.h2: What it will and won't do
sections.html:
We want to be straight with you.

It will firm and smooth skin with early to moderate laxity, improve texture, and give you a visible lift that builds over a series.

It won't replace a surgical facelift. If you have significant sagging or excess skin, RF will soften the appearance but it won't lift it, and a plastic surgeon is the honest answer. We'll tell you if that's where you are.

• Pacemakers, defibrillators or any implanted electronic device
  • Metal implants or permanent fillers in the treatment area
  • Pregnancy
  • Active infection, open wounds or inflamed acne in the area
  • Certain autoimmune conditions

Tell us about any implanted device before you book.

Pricing is confirmed at your consultation, once we've looked at your skin and agreed on a plan. Treatment length, the serums or settings we choose, and any add-ons all affect the cost — so we'd rather quote you accurately than guess.

Call (949) 545-7919 and we'll talk it through.

faqs.q: Does it hurt?
faqs.a: No. It's warm and genuinely relaxing.

faqs.q: How soon will I see something?
faqs.a: There's usually visible tightening the same day. The real change shows up around weeks 8–12.

faqs.q: How long do results last?
faqs.a: The collagen you build is your own, so it ages at a normal rate. Most people maintain with a session every three to four months.

faqs.q: Can I combine it with other treatments?
faqs.a: Yes — it pairs well with DiamondGlow or BREEZE in the same visit. We wouldn't do it on the same day as a peel.

faqs.q: Is it safe for all skin tones?
faqs.a: Yes. RF doesn't target pigment, so unlike some laser treatments there's no added risk for deeper skin tones.

name: Cool Restore Cryo
title: Cryo Facial & Skin Firming in San Clemente | Skin Restore
description: Cool Restore cryo facial in San Clemente. Controlled cooling firms skin, reduces puffiness and calms redness. No downtime — the one to book before an event.
alt: A Cool Restore cryo treatment being applied to a client's face at Skin Restore, San Clemente
intro:
Cold, controlled and immediate. If you need to look your best tomorrow, this is the appointment to make.

Cool Restore delivers targeted cooling within a narrow, controlled temperature range — cold enough to firm and de-puff, precise enough that it never disrupts your skin's protective barrier.

Blood vessels constrict, then flush open again as you warm. The result is skin that looks tighter, calmer and considerably less puffy than it did fifteen minutes earlier.

sections.html:
Reduces puffiness. Cold moves fluid out of tissue. The change around the eyes and jawline is usually visible before you leave.

Calms redness and inflammation. Vasoconstriction quiets irritated, reactive skin. Useful for rosacea-prone complexions between flares.

Temporarily tightens. Pores appear smaller and skin looks firmer.

Boosts circulation. The rebound after the cold brings fresh blood to the surface — that's the flush and glow.

Protects the barrier. Unlike aggressive cold or aggressive exfoliation, the controlled temperature range means your barrier stays intact.

Feels genuinely good. It's invigorating rather than relaxing, and people leave energized.

This is a treatment we love, and we'd rather set expectations properly than oversell it.

Cool Restore gives you an immediate, visible result that typically holds for one to three days, plus a cumulative firming effect over a series. It's excellent as event prep and as a monthly reset for inflammation and puffiness.

What it isn't is a substitute for a resurfacing treatment. If you're after change in pigmentation, scarring or texture, that's a course of peels, and we'll say so.

Length: 10–20 minutes Sensation: Cold and bracing, never painful. The applicator keeps moving so no one area gets too cold. Downtime: None whatsoever Aftercare: None. Makeup straight away if you like.

Often added to the end of another treatment to calm the skin.

• Cold urticaria or cold-related allergic conditions
  • Raynaud's phenomenon
  • Cryoglobulinemia
  • Open wounds or active infection in the treatment area

Tell us about any circulatory condition before we start.

Pricing is confirmed at your consultation, once we've looked at your skin and agreed on a plan. Treatment length, the serums or settings we choose, and any add-ons all affect the cost — so we'd rather quote you accurately than guess.

Call (949) 545-7919 and we'll talk it through.

faqs.q: How soon before an event should I book?
faqs.a: The day before, or the morning of. This is one of the very few treatments that's better closer to the date.

faqs.q: Does it hurt?
faqs.a: No. It's cold in a way that feels invigorating, not painful.

faqs.q: Can I do it every week?
faqs.a: You can. There's no recovery and nothing to over-treat.

faqs.q: Will it help acne?
faqs.a: It calms inflammation, which helps how an angry breakout looks. It won't treat the underlying cause.

name: DermaPlane
title: Dermaplaning in Orange County & San Clemente | Skin Restore
description: Dermaplaning in San Clemente and Orange County. Removes dead skin and fine vellus hair for a smooth, bright finish. Standalone treatment or add-on.
alt: A sterile blade held at an angle against the jawline during a dermaplaning treatment
h1: Dermaplaning in San Clemente & Orange County
intro:
No downtime, no recovery, and the smoothest your skin has felt in years.

Dermaplaning uses a sterile surgical blade held at an angle to sweep away dead surface cells and the fine vellus hair — peach fuzz — that sits on top of them. What's left is skin that catches light instead of dulling it.

sections.h2: Why people keep coming back for this one
sections.html:
It's the treatment clients are most skeptical about and most loyal to afterward.

Makeup sits differently. Foundation goes on smooth instead of catching on fine hair. This is the reason a lot of people book it before events.

Products work harder. You've just removed the barrier of dead cells that was blocking absorption. Your serums finally reach live skin.

Instant brightness. Vellus hair traps light and dulls the complexion. Removing it produces a noticeable change in how skin reflects light.

Zero recovery. Nothing to hide, nothing to wait out. You walk out ready for whatever's next.

• Dull, rough or flaky skin
  • Makeup that never quite sits right
  • Fine lines made more visible by dry surface skin
  • Poor product absorption
  • Unwanted facial peach fuzz

As a standalone treatment — about 30 minutes A full appointment. We cleanse and prep properly, dermaplane the whole face in careful sections, then finish with a treatment mask and the serums your skin needs. Because dermaplaning clears the barrier of dead cells blocking absorption, that finishing step does considerably more work than it would on untreated skin — which is the whole point of doing it as a full service rather than a quick pass.

As an add-on — about 15 minutes Added to the start of another treatment. Dermaplaning first means whatever comes next goes into cleared, receptive skin. It pairs particularly well with BREEZE or DiamondGlow, and it's the most common way clients build it into a regular routine.

We work in small sections with the blade held at roughly a 45-degree angle. It feels like a soft scraping — most people compare it to a very light shaving sensation. There's no pain and nothing sharp is ever pressed into the skin.

Slight pinkness for a few minutes afterward, then you're done.

No, it does not grow back thicker or darker.

This is the single most common worry and it's a myth. Vellus hair is genetically programmed to a set thickness and color. Cutting it doesn't change the follicle. What people are noticing is that the blunt cut end of regrowth can feel coarser than the naturally tapered tip for a few days — it feels different, it isn't different.

Terminal hair (the coarse hair on the chin and upper lip in some people) is a separate hair type and dermaplaning doesn't affect it either.

• Anyone with active, inflamed or pustular acne — the blade can spread bacteria across the face
  • Active cold sores or open lesions
  • Very reactive rosacea in an active flare
  • Anyone on isotretinoin (Accutane) within the last six months

If you have acne, we'll steer you toward a treatment plan built for that instead.

Pricing is confirmed at your consultation, once we've looked at your skin and agreed on a plan. Treatment length, the serums or settings we choose, and any add-ons all affect the cost — so we'd rather quote you accurately than guess.

Call (949) 545-7919 and we'll talk it through.

faqs.q: How often can I have it?
faqs.a: Every four to six weeks, which lines up with your natural skin cell turnover cycle.

faqs.q: Can I just do this at home?
faqs.a: Please don't. The blades sold for home use are duller and the angle is nearly impossible to hold correctly on yourself — which is how people end up with nicks, irritation and uneven results.

faqs.q: Will it help my acne scarring?
faqs.a: Not meaningfully. Dermaplaning works on the surface only. Scarring sits deeper, and a course of medical-grade peels is the better conversation — come in and we'll look at it properly.

faqs.q: Can I get it before a wedding?
faqs.a: Yes — book two to three days before. That's long enough for any pinkness to settle and short enough that you're still perfectly smooth.

name: Chemical Peels
title: Chemical Peels in Orange County | Skin Restore, San Clemente
description: Mild to moderate chemical peels in San Clemente for tone, texture and pigmentation — customized to your skin by a licensed esthetician.
alt: A client resting during a chemical peel appointment at Skin Restore, San Clemente
h1: Chemical Peels in San Clemente & Orange County
intro:
A peel isn't one treatment — it's a category. The difference between a peel that transforms your skin and one that damages it comes down to choosing the right acid, at the right strength, for the right skin.

That's the part we take seriously. We offer mild through moderate peels, and we'll be direct with you about which one you actually need.

sections.html:
A chemical solution is applied to the skin to dissolve the bonds holding dead cells together. Those cells release and shed, revealing newer skin underneath — and the controlled exfoliation prompts your skin to increase cell turnover and collagen production going forward.

How deep that goes determines everything: the result, the recovery time and the risk.

Mild / superficial Targets the outermost layer only. Brightens, smooths, evens tone. Little to no visible peeling — you may just feel slightly dry for a couple of days. Good as a monthly maintenance treatment and safe before events. Best for: dullness, mild congestion, general maintenance

Moderate Reaches deeper into the epidermis. Expect three to five days of visible flaking. This is where you start seeing genuine change in pigmentation and texture. Best for: sun damage, melasma, post-acne marks, deeper lines

Acne-specific Salicylic and mandelic acid formulations that penetrate oil and clear congestion from inside the pore. Best for: active breakouts, blackheads, oily congested skin

Mandelic acid Worth calling out separately. Mandelic has a larger molecule than glycolic, so it penetrates more slowly and evenly — which makes it significantly safer for deeper skin tones, where aggressive peels can trigger post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. We stock 5% and 8% mandelic for home use alongside our in-clinic treatments. Best for: sensitive skin, Fitzpatrick IV–VI, rosacea-prone skin, first-time peel clients

BioRePeel A 35% TCA peel with a biphasic formula designed to renew the skin with minimal visible peeling — the strength of a TCA peel, without the week of flaking. Best for: texture, tone and acne marks when you can't afford downtime

• Sun damage and pigmentation
  • Melasma
  • Acne and post-acne marks
  • Fine lines and texture
  • Dullness and uneven tone
  • Enlarged pores

Before: We may ask you to prep your skin at home for two to four weeks — especially if you're treating pigmentation. This matters. Prepping properly is what makes the difference between an even result and a patchy one.

During: The solution is applied and left on for a set time. You'll feel tingling, warmth or stinging depending on the depth. We monitor the whole time and neutralize when it's right.

After: Depending on depth — anywhere from slight tightness to five days of visible flaking. Do not pick. Do not peel it off. Let it come away on its own or you'll cause scarring or pigmentation.

Sunscreen is non-negotiable afterward. Freshly resurfaced skin burns and pigments easily. This is where people undo their own results.

Pricing is confirmed at your consultation, once we've looked at your skin and agreed on a plan. Treatment length, the serums or settings we choose, and any add-ons all affect the cost — so we'd rather quote you accurately than guess.

Call (949) 545-7919 and we'll talk it through.

faqs.q: Will my face visibly peel?
faqs.a: With a mild peel, usually not — maybe some dryness. With a moderate peel, yes, and you should plan for it. Don't book one three days before a wedding.

faqs.q: Are peels safe for darker skin?
faqs.a: Yes, with the right acid and the right practitioner. We favor mandelic acid and conservative depths for Fitzpatrick IV–VI, and we prep the skin beforehand to reduce pigmentation risk. What we won't do is put an aggressive peel on skin that isn't a good candidate for it.

faqs.q: How many will I need?
faqs.a: For maintenance, one every four to six weeks. For pigmentation or scarring, a series of three to six.

faqs.q: Can I use retinol beforehand?
faqs.a: Stop five to seven days before. Tell us everything you're using — retinoids, acids, prescription products — because it changes how your skin responds.

faqs.q: Is it safe in pregnancy?
faqs.a: Some are, some aren't. Tell us and we'll choose appropriately or recommend something else.

name: Micro Channeling
title: Microchanneling & Nano Needling, San Clemente
description: Microchanneling, also called nano needling, in San Clemente. Stimulates your own collagen and drives growth factor serums deeper. Little downtime.
alt: A microchanneling pen being used during a nano needling treatment
h1: Microchanneling & Nano Needling in San Clemente
intro:
The treatment that works with your skin rather than on it.

Microchanneling creates thousands of tiny channels across the surface of the skin. Two things happen as a result: your skin begins producing fresh collagen to repair them, and the serums we apply reach a depth they could never reach on their own.

The result builds over weeks rather than appearing overnight — and because you're growing your own collagen rather than borrowing someone else's, it lasts.

sections.h2: Nano needling and microchanneling are the same thing
sections.html:
You'll see this treatment called several names — microchanneling, nano needling, nano infusion. They describe the same approach: a pen creates microscopic channels in the surface of the skin so it renews itself, and so the serums applied during treatment reach past the barrier instead of sitting on top of it.

If you've been comparing nano needling with traditional microneedling, the difference that matters is depth. Traditional microneedling works deeper and is aimed at structural change, with more recovery attached. This treatment stays in the surface layers — which is why there's little downtime, why it's comfortable, and why it suits skin that isn't ready for something more aggressive.

Book it under either name. It's the same appointment.

Skin repairs itself constantly. Microchanneling gives it a reason to.

A precision handpiece with a sterile, single-use cartridge passes over the treatment area, creating microscopic channels at a controlled depth. Your skin reads these as something to repair and responds the way it responds to any repair signal — by producing new collagen and elastin in the surrounding tissue.

At the same moment, those channels are open. That's a window that doesn't exist at any other point, and it's why the serum step matters as much as the treatment itself. Growth factor and peptide serums applied during microchanneling reach living tissue instead of sitting on the surface, which is where the vast majority of an expensive serum usually ends up.

• Fine lines — particularly around the eyes and mouth
  • Skin texture — the rough, uneven feel that exfoliating never quite fixes
  • Firmness — as collagen builds, skin regains structure
  • Enlarged pores — improved tone around the pore makes it appear smaller
  • Uneven tone and dullness
  • Overall radiance — increased circulation and cell turnover

1. Consultation and prep We look at your skin, confirm it's the right treatment for you, and review your health history. Then we cleanse thoroughly.

2. The treatment The handpiece passes over the treatment area in sections. Most people describe a light vibration or a mild sandpaper sensation. It takes about 20–30 minutes.

3. Serum infusion Growth factor or peptide serums are applied throughout and immediately afterward, while absorption is at its highest.

4. Aftercare You'll leave with clear instructions and the products you need. We'll tell you exactly what to use and — just as importantly — what to leave alone.

Day of: Redness and warmth, similar to a mild sunburn. Days 1–2: Redness settles. Skin may feel tight or slightly rough. Days 3–5: Light flaking as the surface renews. Skin starts looking brighter. Weeks 4–12: The real work. New collagen forms gradually and texture keeps improving.

Most people need a series of three to six sessions, four to six weeks apart for meaningful change. A single session gives you a glow and better product absorption. It won't remodel your skin's structure on its own, and we'd rather say so now than let you feel let down after one visit.

For 24 hours: no makeup, no working out, no sweating, no swimming. For 72 hours: no retinoids, no acids, no exfoliants, no saunas or hot tubs. For two weeks: sunscreen without exception, and reapply it.

Freshly treated skin is more vulnerable to sun damage and pigmentation than it will be at any other time. Most people who don't love their results skipped this section.

We'll tell you honestly if you're not a candidate:

  • Active acne breakouts, cold sores or any skin infection in the area
  • Isotretinoin (Accutane) within the last six months
  • A history of keloid scarring
  • Recent radiation therapy
  • Certain autoimmune or clotting conditions, or blood-thinning medication
  • Pregnancy or breastfeeding

Tell us what you take and what's going on with your health. It genuinely changes what we do.

Pricing is confirmed at your consultation, once we've looked at your skin and agreed on a plan. Treatment area, serum selection and whether you're booking a series all affect the cost — so we'd rather quote you accurately than guess.

Call (949) 545-7919 and we'll talk it through.

faqs.q: Does it hurt?
faqs.a: Most people find it very manageable — a mild scratching or vibration rather than pain. The forehead and jawline are the most sensitive areas. We check in throughout and adjust.

faqs.q: How is this different from an at-home derma roller?
faqs.a: Precision and sterility. Professional cartridges are sterile and single-use, and depth is controlled rather than guessed at. Home rollers can't reach a useful depth, they tear rather than puncture, and re-using them is a real infection risk.

faqs.q: Can I wear makeup afterwards?
faqs.a: Not for 24 hours. Your skin needs that time.

faqs.q: How soon before an event should I book?
faqs.a: At least two weeks, ideally a month. This is not a day-before treatment.

faqs.q: Is it safe for deeper skin tones?
faqs.a: Yes — this is one of its advantages. Because it uses no heat and no light, the risk of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation is much lower than with laser resurfacing. It's often the better option for Fitzpatrick IV–VI skin.

faqs.q: How long do results last?
faqs.a: The collagen is your own, so it ages with you at a normal rate. Most clients maintain with a session every six to twelve months.

faqs.q: Can I combine it with other treatments?
faqs.a: Not on the same day as a peel or dermaplaning. We'd space those out. It pairs well with BREEZE or Cool Restore in the weeks between sessions.

name: Teen Facial
title: Teen Facial in San Clemente & Orange County
description: Teen facials in San Clemente — gentle, acne-focused treatment with safe professional extractions and a simple home routine. Parents welcome.
alt: A high-frequency electrode being applied to the forehead during a teen facial
intro:
Skin in your teens behaves differently than skin at any other age, and it usually needs less than the internet says it does.

A teen facial at Skin Restore is a proper professional treatment, not a scaled-down adult facial. We clear congestion safely, calm what's inflamed, and send you home with a routine short enough that you'll actually keep to it.

sections.html:
A look at what's actually going on. Different kinds of breakouts need different handling. We work out which you have before treating anything.

Deep cleansing. A thorough double cleanse, then gentle warming to soften the skin and loosen what's in the pores.

Professional extractions. This is the part that matters most. Clearing blackheads and congestion properly — with sterile tools, correct pressure and the right angle — removes the blockage without the bruising, broken capillaries and scarring that come from doing it at home in front of a mirror.

A calming finish. A mask suited to your skin, then a light moisturizer and SPF.

A routine you'll follow. Three or four products, not twelve. We'll show you how to use them and explain what each one is for.

• Blackheads and congestion, especially across the nose and forehead
  • Whiteheads and surface breakouts
  • Oily or shiny skin
  • Skin that's become irritated from too many products
  • Early breakouts, before they become a bigger pattern

Appointment length: About 45 minutes, plus time to talk through home care.

A parent or guardian should attend the first appointment. You'll get the same explanation your teen does, so you both know what the plan is and what the products are for.

We don't upsell to teenagers. The home care we recommend is deliberately minimal, and we'll say plainly when something isn't necessary. Most teen skin gets worse from over-treatment, not under-treatment.

On expectations: consistent, visible improvement usually takes eight to twelve weeks, with monthly appointments alongside a daily routine. Anyone promising clear skin faster than that isn't being straight with you.

When a dermatologist is the right call: if your teen has deep, painful cystic acne — the kind that sits under the skin for weeks and leaves marks — that generally needs prescription medication, and treating it topically wastes months while scarring forms. We'll tell you if that's what we're seeing and refer you. We're happy to handle the esthetic side alongside a dermatologist's care.
Pricing is confirmed at your consultation, once we've looked at the skin and agreed on a plan. Call (949) 545-7919 and we'll talk it through.

faqs.q: How old is a teen facial for?
faqs.a: Roughly 12 to 18. Younger is fine too if there's congestion to treat — give us a call and we'll advise.

faqs.q: Will extractions hurt?
faqs.a: There's some pressure and it can be briefly uncomfortable around the nose. It's very manageable, and we stop if anyone wants a break.

faqs.q: Will my teen's face be red afterwards?
faqs.a: Mild redness for an hour or two where extractions were done. Nothing that needs hiding.

faqs.q: How often should they come in?
faqs.a: Monthly works well and lines up with the skin's natural turnover cycle.

faqs.q: What if they won't stick to a routine?
faqs.a: That's exactly why we keep it to three or four products. A routine that gets followed beats a better routine that doesn't.

faqs.q: Do you treat back and chest breakouts?
faqs.a: Yes — those areas are treated separately from the face. Mention it when you book so we can allow the time.

name: BioRePeel
title: BioRePeel in San Clemente & Orange County | Skin Restore
description: BioRePeel in San Clemente — a 35% TCA biphasic peel that renews skin with minimal visible peeling. For texture, tone, acne marks and fine lines.
alt: The BioRePeel solution beading on the skin, applied topically with a needle-free dispenser
intro:
The benefits of a TCA peel, without a week of peeling.

BioRePeel is a medical-grade peel from Italy built around a 35% TCA formula — a strength that usually means days of visible shedding. Its biphasic formula is designed to work beneath the surface instead, so you get the renewal without the flaking. Most people go straight back to their day.

sections.html:
BioRePeel works in two phases at once.

The renewing phase combines TCA with lactobionic, salicylic, tartaric and citric acids. Together they loosen the bonds between dead surface cells and prompt your skin to renew itself.

The revitalizing phase adds amino acids, vitamins C and B2, and GABA. These support repair and hydration, and help the skin tolerate the treatment comfortably.

The peel itself takes only minutes to apply. The result stimulates cell turnover and collagen production, without the visible peeling a traditional TCA peel causes.

• Dull, tired or uneven-looking skin
  • Rough texture and enlarged pores
  • Acne and post-acne marks
  • Sun damage and pigmentation
  • Fine lines
  • Skin that needs to look its best without downtime

How it's applied: Topically, with a needle-free dispenser. Nothing is injected — the solution is worked across the surface of the skin, where it beads as it goes on.

Length: The peel takes about ten minutes; allow extra time for cleansing and aftercare. Sensation: Tingling and warmth while it works. Very manageable. Downtime: Minimal. Mild redness that usually settles within hours. Most people see little or no visible peeling. Results: Skin looks brighter and feels smoother within days. Lasting change builds over a series.

Protocol: A series of four to six treatments, spaced one to two weeks apart, gives the best results. A single session gives you a noticeable refresh.

Stop retinoids, AHAs and BHAs for about three days before and three days after your peel. Tell us everything else you're using — it changes how your skin responds.

Wear sunscreen every day afterward, and reapply it. Freshly renewed skin is more vulnerable to sun damage, and that's where results get undone.

• Pregnancy or breastfeeding
  • Active cold sores, infection or broken skin in the area
  • Isotretinoin (Accutane) within the last six months
  • A recent sunburn, or a recent laser or resurfacing treatment
  • Known sensitivity to any of the ingredients

faqs.q: Will I actually peel?
faqs.a: Usually very little, if at all — that's the point of the formula. Some people notice light flaking for a day or two; most notice none.

faqs.q: Does it hurt?
faqs.a: No. Expect tingling and warmth for a few minutes while it works.

faqs.q: How is it different from a regular chemical peel?
faqs.a: A traditional TCA peel works by visibly peeling away the surface, which means days of downtime. BioRePeel is designed to renew the skin with minimal visible peeling, so you can keep your plans.

faqs.q: Can I have it before an event?
faqs.a: Yes — it's one of its strengths. Book a few days ahead so any redness has time to settle.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: Four to six, one to two weeks apart, for the full effect. After that, maintenance every few months.

faqs.q: Is it suitable for my skin?
faqs.a: It suits a wide range of skin types. We'll assess your skin first, as always, and tailor the plan to it.
